authLayout.tagline: Class pages, tuition, attendance, and your teacher landing — professional and simple.

landing.title: Your class, elevated
landing.heroSubtitle: Teacher landing pages, attendance, tuition, and parent portal — built for solo tutors and small centers in Vietnam.
landing.featuresTitle: What you get out of the box
landing.featureAuth: Auth (login/register/refresh, Google sign-in, forgot/reset password, verify email)
landing.featureMedia: Media lab: presigned upload → complete → poll status

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: JWT + refresh token. Supports two-factor authentication.
login.twoFaHint: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.apiUnreachable: Cannot reach API. Start backend: cd src/Backend/Api && dotnet run --launch-profile https
login.googleExistingEmailHint: Already registered with email and password? Sign in with Google using the same email to link your account.

account.title: Account settings
account.subtitle: Profile, security, and app preferences in one place.
account.securityHint: Protect your account with an authenticator app. You can turn 2FA off with a valid code.

awaitingVerification.title: Verify your email
awaitingVerification.subtitle: You need to confirm your email before using the app.
awaitingVerification.hint: Open the link in the email, then sign in. The app stays locked until verification is complete.
awaitingVerification.noEmail: Enter your email on the registration or sign-in page first.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Uses idempotency key automatically.
register.success: Registered. Check your email if verification is required.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We will send a reset link if the email exists.
forgotPassword.sent: If that email is registered, a reset link has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.success: Password updated. You can sign in now.

verifyEmail.title: Verify email
verifyEmail.success: Email verified. You can sign in now.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your account and quick links.
dashboard.tip: Use the nav to test Profile, 2FA, and Media Lab.
dashboard.noTenant: No organization yet — subscribe to create one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Install the app and manage push notifications.
settings.installHint: Add this site to your home screen for faster access (PWA).
settings.installManual: Use your browser menu: Install app or Add to Home Screen.
settings.alreadyInstalled: You are using the installed app.
settings.installIosStep1: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
settings.installIosStep2: Open the app from your home screen.
settings.pushHint: Get alerts when you receive in-app notifications (requires permission).
settings.pushDenied: Permission denied. Enable notifications in browser settings.
settings.pushUnavailable: Push is not available. Check WebPush settings on the server.

profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarHint: Profile API has no avatar field yet. Upload demonstrates the media flow for future avatar support.

twoFa.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFa.setupHint: Begin setup → scan QR in authenticator app → enter 6-digit code.

media.title: Media Lab
media.flowHint: Initiate → PUT to presigned URL → Complete → Poll GET until Ready.

google.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured (set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.pageDescription: In-app messages from support, billing, and system events.
notifications.whereToFind: Announcements and alerts appear here and in the bell at the bottom-right of the app.
notifications.bellHint: Tip: use the bell for quick previews; this page shows your full history.
notifications.broadcastDevHint: Admin broadcasts are delivered after the Worker processes the queue (RabbitMQ + Worker must be running locally). Refresh this page or open the bell after a few seconds.

support.title: Support center
support.description: Open and track support tickets with live updates from the admin team.
support.subject: Subject
support.selectTicket: Select a ticket to view details.
support.closedHint: This ticket is closed. Reopen it to send another reply.

pricing.title: Plans & pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose a subscription plan for your organization (tenant).

about.title: About us
about.body: We build a multi-tenant SaaS platform with subscription plans for organizations and a personal credit wallet for metered features on the main app.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Have a question about billing, your account, or anything else? Fill out the form and we'll get back to you.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Describe your question or issue in detail…
contact.successBody: Thanks for reaching out. We'll reply to your email shortly.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to a plan
subscribe.subtitle: Creates a new tenant and subscription (MVP checkout — no payment provider yet).

tenantUsage.title: Organization usage
tenantUsage.subtitle: Subscription status and plan limits for your active tenant.
tenantUsage.cancelConfirm: Cancel this organization's subscription? Write access will be removed.
tenantUsage.ssoHint: Members can sign in with your identity provider using an OIDC id_token.
tenantUsage.ssoClientSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep existing secret
tenantUsage.ssoNotConfigured: SSO is not configured yet. Save to create settings.
tenantUsage.ssoSignInHint: Members sign in with your OIDC provider (configured above).
tenantUsage.inviteSent: Invitation sent (user must already have an account).

tenantPublic.appEntryHint: We set your active tenant context. Continue to the main app for profile, support, and media.
tenantPublic.ssoHint: Use the identity provider configured by your organization admin.
tenantPublic.ssoDisabled: SSO is not enabled for this organization.

wallet.title: Personal wallet
wallet.subtitle: Credits are per user — not tied to your tenant subscription.
wallet.creditsHint: Credits for metered features on the main app
wallet.demoTopUpHint: Manual credit amount without payment (development only).

errors.userNameAlreadyTaken: This username is already taken. Choose another username.

errors.concurrencyConflict: This record was changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
